theme: A wide-open Sunday with three clocks ticking quietly in the background.
greeting: Morning, Dan. One 15-minute sync with Mike at nine, and then the whole day is yours — a rare open Sunday worth spending on the stove or the water. The only real pull on it is a trio of bookings that have been circling, two of which close this week.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 that's slipped since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — a refundable hold costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break — pick the destination
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist was due Sept 30 and the booking deadline is Oct 15. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year; default to a domestic pick, since passports won't be in hand on booking day.

needsAttention.title: Set the Pathfinder drive dates
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap is more than half spent. Lock two drive days and book the single hotel night so the car's south before the rental cycles would otherwise restart.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-minute board sweep — owners and dates on everything, chase what's waiting

flagged.title: A few senior-role alerts overnight
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced several MD- and VP-level roles (US policy, government affairs) — automated alerts rather than outreach, worth a two-minute skim given the search.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — St. Pete local, Italian word of the day, a couple of retailers.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on a reply from you this morning.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its sweetest now, and candied bacon turns a simple pasta into cool-weather comfort.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A fifteen-minute board review with Mike opens the day; after that the calendar is empty.
Nothing else is scheduled — a genuinely clear Sunday, the kind that rewards a from-scratch cook or an afternoon on the water.
No calls on the evening; it's also Andrew's birthday, if that's one to mark.
